Peremyshlyany New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Львівська область, Ukraine

Not demolished. Peremyshlyany's Jewish community, first mentioned in 1581, was home to a Hasidic dynasty founded in the town in the 18th century. In 1875, the first Jewish colonization society of Galicia — an early organization dedicated to resettling Jews in the Land of Israel, predating many later Zionist movements — operated here. Nazi forces briefly occupied the town in September 1939, executing around 600 Jews on the banks of the San River, before re-occupying it in July 1941; a ghetto holding about 3,000 prisoners operated from December 1942 until its liquidation on May 22, 1943, when more than 2,000 people were executed.
